title: 숟가락 하나
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop Hip-Hop track featuring a blend of soulful R&B vocal hooks and rhythmic rap verses. The arrangement centers on a syncopated boom-bap drum pattern with a crisp snare and a deep, rounded sub-bass. A soulful, high-pitched vocal sample loops in the background, layered with lush synthesizer pads and occasional jazzy electric piano chords. The tempo is 92 BPM in the key of G minor. The male vocals transition between melodic singing in the intro and a rhythmic, percussive rap delivery in the verses. Subtle record scratches and vinyl crackle textures are present in the mix.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[high-pitched vocal sample loop, lush synth pads]
(L-A-A-A)
(L-A-A-A)
(Ooh-ooh)

[Verse 1]
[boom-bap drums enter, rhythmic rap vocals]

쇼츠 찍고 돌리면 조회수가 답이야 웃음도 연기하나 나도 모르게 살아가
렌즈 각도 맞추고 조명 아래서 봐 내 표정까지 상품이 되는 거 봐
리얼타임 좋아요가 자존심이야 근데 그거 빠지면 나는 허수아비야
댓글 알림 울릴 때 심장이 뛰잖아 그게 진짜 감정인지 나도 모르잖아

[Chorus]
[melodic singing, bass deepens]
